frozen_predictions.reliability_gate: split-half (random item halves within the half, 50 splits) Spearman-Brown across edits >= 0.6

bootstrap.unit: edits (with replacement, grouped CV) x semantic items within half (same draw EN/SL)

mixed_model.formula: d ~ bs(EN_A R*, 4) * bs(margin, 4) + lang + lang:EN_A R* + (1|item) + vc(edit)
mixed_model.approximation: statsmodels MixedLM: groups = semantic item, crossed edit effect as a variance component
mixed_model.interpretation: sl:x < 0 means SL items move less per unit of EN_A edit strength than EN items with the SAME original margin
